description: Implementation of bitmap operations for jemalloc, including initialization, size calculation, and support for tree-based or flat bitmap structures.

methods.name: bitmap_info_init
methods.description: Initializes bitmap information structure based on number of bits, supporting tree or flat structure.

methods.name: bitmap_info_ngroups
methods.description: Returns the number of groups in the bitmap info.

methods.name: bitmap_init
methods.description: Initializes a bitmap to either all zeros or all ones, considering extra bits.

methods.name: bitmap_size
methods.description: Calculates the total size in bytes of the bitmap based on its info.
